content:
The answer is:

b) Likely

Explanation:
"Likely" means there is a high probability that something will happen. When a school-wide event is scheduled for a specific day (in this case, Friday), it implies that the event is planned and there are expectations for it to occur. While something unexpected could potentially disrupt the event, the default assumption is that it will take place as scheduled.

• "Certain" would mean the event will absolutely, 100% happen without any doubt.
• "Unlikely" suggests the event probably won't happen.
• "Impossible" means the event cannot happen under any circumstances.

"Likely" best represents the probability of a scheduled school event occurring on its planned day.
